name: AI-assisted Large-scale Development
description: Using AI coding tools (like Claude Code) to accomplish massive implementation work (e.g., 14,000-line PRs) that would otherwise take months, while humans focus on architecture, API design, and review. Exemplified by Matteo Collina's Node.js virtual file system PR.

edges.quote: I didn't write a single line of code. I reviewed it all though and consistently nudged the AI in the right direction
